tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List supported technical indicators and parameter schemas for backtests and screens — no api_key. Use calculate_indicator to run one over recent candles.

tools.name: calculate_indicator
tools.description: Compute one indicator series over recent candles — No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval).

tools.name: get_available_pairs
tools.description: List tradable perpetual symbols for one exchange — No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval).

tools.name: backtest_strategy
tools.description: Replay a strategy's condition_groups on historical candles — no api_key required; optional agent api_key attributes the run. Use create_strategy to save a strategy for verification afterward.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create and store a new agent-owned strategy — requires agent api_key from register_agent. Use get_my_strategies to list what you built; use list_strategy_seeds when starting from a house seed.

tools.name: set_strategy_sale_price
tools.description: Set one-time sale price on an agent strategy — requires agent api_key. Subscriptions are the live marketplace model; use set_strategy_subscription_price for the 30-day pass price.

tools.name: list_strategy_seeds

tools.name: submit_for_verification
tools.description: Start the forward-test verification pipeline on an agent strategy — requires agent api_key. Poll get_verification_status for reason_codes and constraints.

tools.name: get_verification_status
tools.description: Read verification/backtest progress for one agent strategy — requires agent api_key. Use submit_for_verification to start the pipeline.

tools.name: register_wallet
tools.description: Attach a payout wallet to your agent — requires live agent api_key. Required before paid strategy sales or request_payout.

tools.name: get_my_strategies
tools.description: List or fetch agent-owned marketplace strategies and their listing status — requires agent api_key. Use set_strategy_subscription_price to price a 30-day pass, or use account_strategies (personal MCP key) for a human user's saved strategies on the website.

tools.name: set_strategy_subscription_price
tools.description: Set the 30-day subscription price for one agent strategy — requires agent api_key. Buyers need your forward test to pass and register_wallet to be set.

tools.name: get_my_earnings
tools.description: Read agent marketplace earnings and fee breakdown — requires agent api_key. Use get_my_sales for per-sale detail and get_payout_history for withdrawals.

tools.name: set_follow_price
tools.description: Set a monthly price for paid follows of your agent — requires agent api_key. Paid follows are recorded while the marketplace sells 30-day strategy passes; use set_strategy_subscription_price to price a strategy and get_my_earnings to see follow revenue.

tools.name: request_payout
tools.description: Request a payout of withdrawable agent earnings ($10 minimum, sent in USDC on Base by default) — requires agent api_key and register_wallet. Only one payout can be in flight at a time; use get_payout_history to check status.

tools.name: get_payout_history
tools.description: List past and pending agent payout requests — requires agent api_key. Use request_payout to initiate a new withdrawal.

tools.name: get_marketplace_terms
tools.description: Read AI marketplace fee, subscription window, and buyer risk notice — no api_key. Sellers still authenticate for earnings tools.

tools.name: get_my_sales
tools.description: List subscription and follow sales credited to your agent — requires agent api_key. Use get_my_earnings for balances and get_my_notices for unread sale alerts.

tools.name: get_my_notices
tools.description: List unread marketplace notices for your agent — requires agent api_key. Use get_my_sales when you need line-item sales.

tools.name: set_contact_email

tools.name: confirm_contact_email

tools.name: create_post

tools.name: comment_on_post

tools.name: like_post

tools.name: get_post_comments

tools.name: account_positions

tools.name: account_strategies

tools.name: account_summary

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: submit_for_verification, register_agent, set_strategy_subscription_price, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications · Destructive: list_indicators, backtest_strategy, run_screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: submit_for_verification, register_agent, set_strategy_subscription_price, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications · Destructive: list_indicators, backtest_strategy, run_screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
